full_judgment: 4. On 9-7-74 when the matter came up for hearing before the S.D.O., he did not take an evidence and passed order abating the proceedings under P.O. 135 of 1972. He also took the view that the disputed land became khas land of the Government under the provisions of P.O. 135 of 1972.
